text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy was interviewed, but she 
couldn't bring herself to share her dream 
of "becoming a hero." She feared being 
mocked for such an audacious goal.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Symboli Kris S proudly declared 
her goal to conquer the Derby. Zenno Rob 
Roy looked upon her with eyes full of 
envy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
However... accompanying her in training 
brought a realization: that strength was 
forged through relentless effort and an 
unyielding will.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
They say Symboli Kris S's gaze was like a 
treasured blade. An unblemished edge 
shining brilliantly in the morning light.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy resolved to do everything in 
her power to claim that sword herself, 
dedicating herself even further to her 
training.
